name: Animate Dead
description: You imbue a corpse or pile of bones with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as a skeleton or zombie under your control for 24 hours. You command your undead with a bonus action, and recasting the spell reasserts control over up to four of them (more with a higher-level slot).

name: Aura of Vitality
description: Healing energy radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation. When the aura appears and at the start of each of your turns, you may restore 2d6 hit points to one creature within it.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: You fill any number of creatures you choose with hope and vigor: each has advantage on Wisdom and death saving throws, and every die rolled to heal them counts as its maximum.

name: Bestow Curse
description: Your touch curses a creature that fails a Wisdom save: choose to blight one ability score, hinder its attacks against you, make it risk wasting its actions, or make your attacks and spells deal it an extra 1d8 necrotic damage. Higher slots stretch the curse to hours, and a 5th-level slot needs no concentration.

name: Blinding Smite
description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage and the target must make a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends. Higher slots add 1d8 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Call Lightning
description: A storm cloud crackles overhead and you call down bolts of lightning: each creature within 5 feet of a point you choose makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. You can call another bolt as an action on later turns, and a real storm overhead makes each bolt stronger.

name: Clairvoyance
description: You create an invisible sensor at a familiar location within a mile, and see or hear through it as if you were there, switching senses as an action. The sensor is immobile but reveals a room as surely as standing in it.

name: Conjure Animals
description: Nature spirits gather as a Large pack of spectral animals — wolves, serpents, or birds — that you can move 30 feet whenever you move. Any creature the pack closes with, or that enters or ends its turn within 10 feet of it, makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 slashing damage, once per turn.

name: Conjure Barrage
description: You brandish a weapon and a volley of its spectral duplicates streaks out in a 60-foot cone. Each creature of your choice in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Counterspell
description: When you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell, you reach out to snuff the magic: the caster makes a Constitution saving throw, and on a failure its spell is countered and fizzles with no effect. On a success, the casting completes normally.

name: Create Food and Water
description: You conjure 45 pounds of bland but nourishing food and 30 gallons of clean water on the ground or in containers — enough to stave off hunger and thirst for a company of travelers, though the food spoils after a day.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation. While it lasts, you and your allies deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage whenever you hit with a weapon or an unarmed strike.

name: Daylight
description: True sunlight blazes from a point or object you touch, filling a 60-foot sphere with bright light and banishing any darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower that it overlaps.

name: Dispel Magic
description: You unravel magic on one creature, object, or effect: every spell of 3rd level or lower on it ends at once, and for stronger spells you make a spellcasting ability check against each to tear it away. Cast with a higher slot, it automatically ends any spell of that slot's level or lower.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magical, gaining a +1 bonus to attack rolls and dealing an extra 1d4 damage of an element you choose — acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Higher slots sharpen both the bonus and the elemental bite.

name: Fear
description: You project each victim's worst fear in a 30-foot cone: creatures that fail a Wisdom save drop what they hold and flee, spending their turns Dashing away from you until they save at the end of a turn, which they can only attempt once out of your sight.

name: Feign Death
description: A willing creature you touch falls into a cataleptic state indistinguishable from death — blinded, incapacitated, and resistant to nearly all damage, yet unharmed by the pretense. The spell ends early if you dismiss it or the target is disturbed by outside force.

name: Fireball
description: A bead of fire streaks to a point you choose and erupts in a 20-foot sphere of flame. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

name: Fly
description: A willing creature you touch gains a flying speed of 60 feet until the spell ends — though if the magic fades mid-flight, it falls. Higher slots lift additional creatures.

name: Gaseous Form
description: A willing creature and everything it carries dissolve into misty vapor: it flies slowly, slips through the tiniest cracks, and shrugs off most damage, but cannot speak, fight, or manipulate objects until it resolidifies.

name: Glyph of Warding
description: You inscribe a charged glyph on a surface or object and set its trigger. When sprung, explosive runes blast everything within 20 feet for 5d8 damage of an element you chose (Dexterity save for half), or a spell glyph stored inside discharges a spell you cast into it.

name: Haste
description: A willing creature surges with speed: its speed doubles, it gains +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saves, and it gets an extra action each turn for attacks, dashing, or dodging. When the spell ends, the rush drains away and it loses a turn to lethargy.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: You tear open a 20-foot sphere of cold, lightless void filled with milky, rubbery tentacles. Creatures starting their turn inside take 2d6 cold damage, the area is difficult terrain, and at the end of a turn the tentacles lash out — a failed Dexterity save means 2d6 acid damage.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: A twisting pattern of colors weaves through a 30-foot cube. Each creature in it that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and incapacitated, rooted in a stupor until it is shaken awake or takes damage.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
description: A 10-foot dome of force springs up around you and up to nine companions, opaque from outside and comfortable within. Nothing — creatures, objects, or spells — can pass its barrier, making it a near-perfect shelter for a night's rest.

name: Lightning Arrow
description: Cast in the instant your ranged attack lands or misses, your weapon or ammunition becomes a bolt of lightning: the target takes 4d8 lightning damage instead of the attack's normal effects (half on a miss), and every creature within 10 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d8 lightning damage, half on a success.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A stroke of lightning blasts out in a 100-foot line. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success, and flammable objects in the path ignite.

name: Magic Circle
description: Glowing runes circle a 10-foot cylinder, barring celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead (your choice): they cannot willingly enter, attack those inside at disadvantage, and cannot charm or possess them; one that tries to cross by teleportation or interplanar travel must first succeed on a Charisma save. Reversed, the circle becomes a prison for one such creature.

name: Major Image
description: You craft a fully sensory illusion — sight, sound, smell, even temperature — of an object, creature, or scene up to a 20-foot cube, and can animate it as an action. Cast with a 6th-level slot or higher, it lasts until dispelled without concentration.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: A word of restoration spoken over the fray: up to six creatures of your choice that you can see regain 2d4 hit points plus your spellcasting ability modifier. It has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Meld into Stone
description: You step into a stone surface large enough to hold you and merge with it, hidden from every sense while you listen dimly to the world outside. Partly destroying the stone (or reshaping it so you no longer fit) expels you and deals 6d6 force damage to you, and its total destruction deals you even more grievous force damage.

name: Nondetection
description: A willing creature or an object you touch is wiped from magical sight: it cannot be targeted by divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors for the duration.

name: Phantom Steed
description: A quasi-real, horselike creature coalesces to carry you or a rider you choose at a swift 100 feet per round. When the spell ends or the steed is struck, it fades away over a minute rather than vanishing at once.

name: Plant Growth
description: Plants in a 100-foot radius erupt into thick overgrowth that makes the ground difficult terrain. Or, with eight hours of casting, you enrich the land for a mile around, doubling the year's harvest.

name: Protection from Energy
description: A willing creature you touch gains resistance to one damage type you choose — acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder — for the duration.

name: Remove Curse
description: At your touch, every curse afflicting a creature or object breaks and ends. A cursed magic item stays cursed in itself, but its owner is freed from the curse and can let go of it.

name: Revivify
description: You touch a creature that died within the last minute and, at the cost of diamonds the spell consumes, return it to life with 1 hit point. It cannot restore the dead of old age or replace missing body parts.

name: Sending
description: You whisper a message of 25 words or fewer directly into the mind of a creature you have met, across any distance — even another plane, though the crossing fails one time in twenty. The recipient hears you, knows you, and may answer in kind at once.

name: Sleet Storm
description: Freezing rain and sleet lash a 20-foot-wide, 40-foot-tall cylinder, heavily obscuring it and coating the ground in ice. Creatures in the area when it appears, and those that enter or end their turn there, make a Dexterity save or fall prone and risk losing concentration.

name: Slow
description: You seize the flow of time around up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube that fail a Wisdom save: their speed halves, their AC and Dexterity saves drop, they lose reactions, and each turn they can manage only an action or a bonus action, with spells risking a delayed casting. The save repeats at the end of each turn.

name: Speak with Dead
description: You grant a corpse the semblance of life to answer up to five questions, though it knows only what it knew in life and owes you no honesty. The spell fails on a body already questioned this way within the past ten days.

name: Speak with Plants
description: Plants in a 30-foot emanation around you wake to limited sentience: you can question them about the past day's passersby and weather, order plant-choked ground to clear or clear ground to tangle, and speak with plant creatures as if you shared a tongue.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Protective spirits — angelic, fey, or fiendish as suits your faith — flit around you in a 15-foot emanation. Enemies within move at half speed, and each makes a Wisdom save when caught in the aura, taking 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (chosen when you cast) on a failure or half on a success.

name: Stinking Cloud
description: A 20-foot sphere of nauseating yellow gas rolls into being, heavily obscuring its area. A creature fully inside it at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the start of its next turn — retching and reeling, unable to take actions or bonus actions.

name: Tongues
description: A creature you touch gains the gift of tongues: it speaks and understands any language it hears for the duration, and its words are understood by any creature that knows a language.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Your hand is wreathed in shadow that drinks life: make a melee spell attack to deal 3d6 necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to half of it. You can strike again on each of your turns until the spell ends.

name: Water Breathing
description: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to breathe underwater for a full day, while keeping their normal breathing as well.

name: Water Walk
description: Up to ten willing creatures treat any liquid surface — water, acid, mud, snow, even lava — as solid ground for an hour. A submerged target is buoyed gently to the surface, though standing on lava still burns.

name: Wind Wall
description: A wall of rushing wind 50 feet long and 15 feet high springs up where you choose; when it appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength save, taking 4d8 bludgeoning damage on a failure. Arrows and small flying creatures cannot pass it, gases and vapors are blown aside, and loose material is hurled about within it.
